quoted.text:
You can now install Claude artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows.

Ask Claude to build an artifact, click "Install as app", and open it like any other app. It can use your connectors and, if you allow it, send notifications or add a menu bar item. https://t.co/8CBgqe5OKq
quoted.text_zh:
现在可以把 Claude artifacts 安装为 Mac 和 Windows 上的桌面应用了。

让 Claude 做一个 artifact，点击 "Install as app"，就能像打开其他应用一样打开它。它可以调用你的 connectors，如果授权，还能发送通知或添加菜单栏图标。 https://t.co/8CBgqe5OKq

posts.text:
What a year this has been! Time to reflect and do a blog post over the holidays.

OC is in a great place, we found a niche in prosumer and enterprise adoption. The multiplayer team feature is best in class.

Shipping reliable and free open source is also really really hard, and waking up to countless user complaints every day is an emotional challenge. I’m glad the team is taking over most of the work these days.

We mostly been focussing on the boring part of ensuring things are fast, reliable and secure, with the exception of the new memory system and soon OpenClaw ID. 

To many more years!
posts.text_zh:
今年真是了不起的一年！假期里得好好回顾一下，写篇博客。

OC 现在状态很好，我们在 prosumer 和企事业采用上找到了自己的定位。多人协作的团队功能是业内一流。

把可靠且免费的开源持续交付出去，其实非常非常难，每天一睁眼就面对无数用户投诉，这在情绪上也是很大的挑战。很高兴团队现在已经把大部分工作接手过去了。

我们主要一直在做那些不太起眼的部分：确保产品足够快、可靠、安全，例外是新的 memory 系统，以及即将推出的 OpenClaw ID。

愿我们还能走很多年！

quoted.text:
It's OpenClaws One Year Anniversary!

The best part of building in the open this past year has been seeing what you’ve made with it. 

Thanks to everyone who shipped a patch, shared a setup, or helped someone get started

A look back at year one
https://t.co/4reusyeR7b https://t.co/seVqmbyvpA
quoted.text_zh:
今天是 OpenClaws 一周年！

过去这一年开源共建最棒的部分，就是看到你们用它做出来的东西。

感谢每一位提交过补丁、分享过配置、或帮别人入门的人

回顾第一年
